title: Longest Matched Bracket Run
description:
## Task

A text made only of the characters `(`, `)`, `[`, `]`, `{` and `}` is given. A stretch of consecutive characters is matched when every opening bracket in it is closed by a bracket of the same kind, in the right order, and every closing bracket closes one opened inside the stretch (so `([]){}` is matched, `([)]` and `(]` are not). The empty stretch counts as matched. Find the length of the longest matched stretch.

## Input

- `text` — a string of bracket characters. It may be empty.

## Output

An integer: the length of the longest matched stretch, or `0` if there is none.

## Example

```python
longest_matched_bracket_run('([]){}')  # returns 6
longest_matched_bracket_run('([)]')  # returns 0
longest_matched_bracket_run('(()[]')  # returns 4
```

## Constraints

- 0 ≤ length of `text` ≤ 10^5
- Only the six bracket characters appear.
- Expect large inputs; testing every stretch separately may be too slow.
